row: Welcome to Swagx Vet Clinic – your trusted source for professional veterinary education, animal health tips, livestock management, and pet care. Our channel provides accurate, practical, and easy-to-understand videos on cattle, goats, sheep, poultry, dogs, cats, and other animals. Learn about disease prevention, diagnosis, treatment, surgery, reproduction, nutrition, biosecurity, and modern farming practices through real-life cases, 3D educational animations, and expert guidance. Whether you're a farmer, veterinary student, animal owner, or fellow veterinarian, you'll find valuable content to improve animal welfare and productivity. Subscribe and join us in promoting healthier animals and successful farming across Africa and beyond.
